newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Vendex ups Vedior flotation price range.
newsitem.headline: Vendex ups Vedior flotation price range.

text.p: Retail and business services group Vendex International NV said on Thursday it raised the price range for the flotation of shares in its temporary employment services offshoot Vedior to 37 to 40 guilders.
Vedior shares were initially to be floated at a price in between 33 and 37 guilders.
Vendex said strong international demand from both retail and institutional investors, and the strong increase in share prices of international services companies was behind the change.
Investors may modify subscriptions already made until the issue closes at 1300 GMT on June 4.
Allocation of the shares to investors and the start of trading in the shares are expected on June 5, Vendex said.
